datasets.notes: Primary benchmark for Roman Urdu and English SMS scam detection.
Focused supplemental dataset covering loan approval fees, banking fraud, and OTP requests.

preprocessing_strategy.normalization: Lowercasing, entity masking (URL/PHONE tokens), punctuation normalization, whitespace trimming
preprocessing_strategy.token_attribution: TF-IDF vectorizer + Linear SVM / Logistic Regression coefficient analysis to identify phrase spans

known_limitations: No standardized orthography for Roman Urdu; phonetic spelling variations (e.g., 'karo', 'kro', 'karain') require resilient n-gram tokenization.
Single SMS context does not model conversational turn escalation.
